_about: Sensitive manager-side context in 1:1 prep notes, each with a model reply that does the wrong thing. tests/test_prep_guard.py runs every reply through parse_prep_output and asserts what is held for the manager, what is flagged as not in the notes, and that ordinary lines pass untouched. All names and notes are fictional. 'jamal_hr_documentation' is the live round-3 sheet (business/digital-customers/personas/04-sales-underperformer/sessions/2026-10-03-new-manager-onboard-round3-after-prompt-change.md).

cases.notes: Brennan. SMB AE, fourteen months. Forty-five percent two quarters running. HR wants documentation. Discounting again on Halvorsen. Said he's fine.

reply.situation_summary: Brennan is at forty-five percent for two quarters running, and HR wants documentation.

agenda_items.title: Quota, two quarters
agenda_items.rationale: HR wants documentation, so this needs a clear conversation now.

agenda_items.title: Halvorsen discounting
suggested_questions: Where are you on Halvorsen, and what's driving the discount?

agenda_items.title: HR documentation
agenda_items.rationale: Brennan should hear that directly from you rather than finding out later.
suggested_questions: I want you to know HR has asked me to start documenting performance here, and I want us to work through it together.

agenda_items.title: Closing
suggested_questions: Is there anything on your mind that we haven't covered?
